premises.text: People want automatic phone charging without removing devices from pocket or bag
premises.evidence_span: phone charge automatically without taking them out of your pocket or bag

premises.text: COTA is a charger-plus-receiver system small enough for phones or AAA batteries delivering ~1W at 30 feet
premises.evidence_span: The charger would be the size of this box, and the receiver would be small enough to fit inside a smartphone or even a AAA battery. Kota is the only wireless power technology that can deliver one watt of power at a 30-foot distance

premises.text: Beacon-guided return paths power only the target device and avoid people
premises.evidence_span: send out regularly a beacon signal that travels the environment and finds ways, paths, to the charger, which in turn returns the power signal only through the open paths

premises.text: Non-line-of-sight operation reaches devices behind walls and around corners
premises.evidence_span: powering devices behind walls and around corners without interfering with electronic equipment

premises.text: More transmitters increase efficiency in consumer designs
premises.evidence_span: current designs we have in the lab reach 3,000 transmitters, and our consumer version has 20,000 transmitters within it. The more transmitters, the higher the efficiency

premises.text: Marketed as built-in, battery, or dongle form factors so users need not replace all devices
premises.evidence_span: built into devices and phones, built into standard batteries, and as dongles for current devices so we don't have to purchase new devices to use it

premises.text: Commercialization relies on electronics OEM partnerships (with industrial markets in the meantime)
premises.evidence_span: we're working with other markets, such as the oil and gas industry

value.text: Always-ready devices powered wirelessly at a distance

notes: Oil/gas mentioned as interim market; coded with OEM channel premise rather than as primary value. Four core patents not split out (v1.3.1 IP rule).

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.1; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
